fsm_states.name: IDLE
actions: Wait for chip-select (spec §4: CS# assert begins a transaction)

fsm_states.name: RX_CMD
transitions: RX_CMD -> RX_CRC after 8-bit CMD opcode + command fields + optional data
actions: Sample command-specific fields and optional payload (spec §4)

fsm_states.name: RX_CRC
transitions: RX_CRC -> TURNAROUND when CRC valid (or CRC disabled)
actions: Sample CRC byte and check CRC-8 poly 0x07 (spec §10)

fsm_states.name: TURNAROUND
transitions: TURNAROUND -> WAIT_STATE when slave not ready
actions: Float bus for 2 ESPI_CLK cycles (TAR, spec §4/§13)
Take bus ownership for the response phase

fsm_states.name: WAIT_STATE
actions: Drive WAIT_STATE bytes (0x0F nibble) before response code (spec §6/§11)

fsm_states.name: DRIVE_RESP
transitions: DRIVE_RESP -> DRIVE_STATUS_CRC after 8-bit response code + data

fsm_states.name: DRIVE_STATUS_CRC
transitions: DRIVE_STATUS_CRC -> DEASSERT after 16-bit STATUS + CRC byte
actions: Drive response CRC byte (CRC-8 poly 0x07, spec §10)

fsm_states.name: RESP_ERROR
actions: Return NON_FATAL_ERROR (0x02) / FATAL_ERROR (0x03) on CRC or protocol error (spec §6)

fsm_states.name: DEASSERT
actions: Release the bus; complete transaction on CS# deassert (spec §4)

slave_fsm: Insert WAIT_STATE bytes if not ready
control_logic.flow_control: Per-channel FREE/AVAIL bits in STATUS gate PUT/GET; DEFER for non-posted; completion returned later.
control_logic.alert: Slave drives ESPI_ALERT# (or ESPI_IO[1] in single-slave dedicated-alert mode); master responds with GET_STATUS.
